items.title: Order a rainy-day account
items.instructions: Arrange the events into a coherent sequence.

segments.text: Finally, she arrived at the community centre.
Then, she stopped under a shop awning.

payload.explanation: The sequence moves from leaving, to rain, to shelter, to arrival.

items.title: Choose the natural collocation
items.instructions: Choose the natural phrase for choosing a new route.

payload.explanation: English commonly uses make with decision.

items.title: Construct a sequenced event
items.instructions: Use all required words to add the final event to a story.

payload.primary_answer: Finally, we made a decision to wait.
acceptable_variants: Finally, we made a decision to wait.
payload.scoring_guidance: Require finally and the complete phrase made a decision to wait.

items.title: Listen for sequence and focus
items.instructions: Use the transcript as a listening script and answer both questions.

payload.transcript: First, I checked the kitchen. Next, I looked outside. Finally, I found my keys in the BEDROOM, not the hallway.

questions.text: Which place is contrasted with the hallway?

items.title: Write four clear events
items.instructions: Create a short account with four explicitly ordered events.

payload.communicative_goal: Tell a coherent four-event story that includes a decision.
constraints: Use first, next, then, and finally once each.
payload.expected_output: Four one-event sentences in a logical order.

rubric.criterion: Each sequencer marks the intended chronological step.
Made a decision is used naturally in the past account.
